long_biography.plain_text:
From Mahmudavar in Azerbaijan's Masalli district, Babayev studied law at Azerbaijan State University and international economics in Moscow. He entered the aluminium business in 2002, becoming general director of Det.Al Holding and Det.Al Aluminium as the group developed the Ganja complex. His remit also included board and legal responsibilities at Azeraluminium.

In Turkey, Babayev took on roles across tourism and property. He was appointed chairman of the Alva Donna group, which operated three Antalya resort hotels and the Shemall shopping centre, and established Siyahdeniz Tourism Construction in Istanbul. The company's stated activities covered property acquisition, sales and brokerage.
